job.job_description:
Role: Full-stack Developer(Python+ React)

Experience:5+ Years

Preferred Skills: React, Microservices, RESTful APIs., AI-Assisted Development, Node/Python/.net/Golang

Location: Noida (Hybrid)




Role & responsibilities:

Design and develop scalable backend services, microservices, and RESTful APIs, primarily using Python.
Build and maintain modern React-based SPAs with a focus on scalability, usability, and performance.
Develop self-service application workflows covering onboarding, environment provisioning, deployments, and governance controls.
Build solutions that simplify complex infrastructure requirements such as multi-cloud, multi-region, HA, and DR.
Leverage AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Antigravity, and GitHub Copilot while ensuring code quality, testing, security, and production readiness.
Translate product requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, and scalable solutions in collaboration with the client's Cloud Engineering team.
Implement strong testing, CI/CD, observability, and reliability practices to ensure predictable and stable deployments.
Participate in architecture/design reviews, code reviews, sprint ceremonies, and collaborate closely with the India-based engineering pod and client stakeholders.


Requirements

5-8 years of overall software development experience
3+ years of production experience in backend development (Node/Python/.net/Golang)
Experience developing microservices and RESTful APIs
Hands-on experience with React and modern Single Page Applications.
Experience working in a high-velocity engineering environment
Experience using AI coding assistants to accelerate development while maintaining code quality and production standards.
